reason: The dragon needs a secure mounting point on the whale, so its bracket is a practical place to start.
expectation: The bracket will attach to the whale's deck, ready to hold the dragon.

alternatives.reason: The bracket might instead attach to the dragon before mounting it.

effect: The dragon bracket is now mounted on the whale, ready for the attraction.
reason: The mounted bracket should now hold the dragon securely.
expectation: The dragon will attach to its mount on the front deck.

effect: The dragon is aboard, with its mechanism and wing clearance accounted for. The theatre still needs mounting.
reaction: It is satisfying that the earlier mounting holes have a use here.
reason: The theatre needs its own bracket before it can be secured to the whale.
expectation: The bracket will attach to the whale, ready to hold the star theatre.

effect: The theatre bracket is mounted, providing a place to attach the star theatre.
reason: The theatre can now be secured to its mount.
expectation: The star theatre will attach to the bracket behind the dragon.

effect: Both attractions are mounted with clearance to operate; the accessory supply remains to be fitted.
reaction: The attention to the projector's sightline makes the mounting feel purposeful.
reason: The fused accessory supply is the remaining piece and should provide power for the attractions.
expectation: The supply will connect to the mounted attractions.

effect: The accessory supply is fitted and the chapter's goal is complete, but the two shafts still need motor connections to turn under power.
reaction: I was surprised that fitting the supply did not connect the mechanisms to motors.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the dragon was most worthwhile: its earlier mounting holes had a clear use, and checking the wing sweep connected construction to how it actually works.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two brackets was predictable, though it made sense as preparation for securing the attractions.

surprise.text: The supply left the shafts needing separate motor connections; power alone did not make the attractions turn.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary. The brackets and operating clearances gave the mounting steps clear purposes.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the shafts are driven and how the assembled fair works, although this chapter's mounting sequence was fairly predictable.
